apps.title: Invoice Maker - Invoice Fly
apps.shortDesc: Make invoices, bills, receipts & estimates on the go with Invoice Generator.
apps.fullDesc:
Invoice Fly is the easiest way to create and send professional invoices to your clients. It’s perfect for small businesses, freelancers and contractors. Whether you need to create and invoice or estimate, Invoice Fly is the #1 invoice app for the job.


Keep your finances organized with Invoice Fly, where you can easily create, send and track invoices on your phone.


You will be able to configure as many details as you need, adding payment information, taxes, withholding, due dates, extra images, discount, signature and more. Also, you will be notified when the customer receives and opens your invoice.


Features:
-Create invoices in less than a minute, anywhere you are.
-Generate invoices from estimates with a tap.
-Choose from different invoice templates and customize them.
-Attach images and additional notes.
-Discounts per item or total.
-Taxes per item or total.
-Add signature.
-Share or print invoices on the go.
-Quickly setup clients from your phone contact list.
-Sync all your devices with the same account.
-Track your incomes with easy to use reports.
-Get notified when the client receives and opens your invoice.
-24/7 support


Creating and sending an invoice has never been so easy:
Step 1: Tap create invoice
Step 2: Select your client to bill, easily from your contacts
Step 3: Add the desired items and prices
Step 4: You are ready to go, save and send.
